metadata.title: European Stroke Organisation (ESO) guideline on motor rehabilitation
top_takeaways: High-intensity gait training is strongly recommended to improve walking endurance in individuals with chronic stroke and stable cardiovascular status.
Providing an additional minimal dose of 20 hours of upper limb practice or walking practice is recommended to improve arm and gait capacity post-stroke.
Task-specific group-based therapy is a non-inferior alternative to individual therapy for balance and gait outcomes, while additional sit-to-stand training improves balance.

recommendations.statement: An additional minimal dose of 20 hours of repetitive upper limb practice is recommended to improve arm capacity.
recommendations.target_population: People post-stroke requiring upper limb motor rehabilitation

recommendations.statement: An additional minimal dose of 20 hours of walking practice could be provided to improve walking capacity.

recommendations.verbatim_quote: An additional minimal dose of 20 hours of walking practice could be provided to improve walking capacity.
